description: Agentic customer service and commerce platform for retail and support teams
auth_notes: Uses API tokens (bearer tokens) generated from the Gladly admin settings to authenticate REST API requests.
credential_notes: API access requires an active commercial Gladly customer account and admin privileges to generate API tokens.
api_notes: Covers REST APIs for customer data, conversations, tasks, webhooks, and lookup integrations.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Gladly.
rationale: The REST API is publicly documented and accessible, but obtaining API credentials requires a paid commercial Gladly account.

evidence.note: Gladly developer portal showing REST APIs, webhooks, and SDKs.
Documentation detailing how to generate API tokens from Gladly settings.
